no_lever.why_no_lever: The corllt was out of sight ('shelled from out of sight by a corllt ... from the north-west') and not a party, so group_N_t4's menu at 10:12 had no move against it: only go_spot_37 (0.20) and fight_to_shelling (0.48); the pick took the route's next stop (fight_to_spot_44, 0.50) and Opus wrote at 10:15 'It has left E4 behind'. No move attacks a known building by place when it is not in sight.

no_lever.wanted: 'one body of about 5,800 fights it at t4_line ... on t4's 24 turrets, Lashers behind Brutes and Pounders' (two seats' groups made one body at once)
no_lever.why_no_lever: The commander's only lever is transfer plus prose; the receiving seat's hands read only their own player's packet, so a direction that arrives after the transfer leaves the given units to the old packet (t4's of 16:57 did not name them). There is no commander-side way to give the hands a standing task with the units.
